metadata.description: Evaluation benchmark targeting the 10 core doctrinal and evidentiary failure modes in multi-statute Indian legal retrieval.

queries.query: What punishment is prescribed for theft under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita?

incompatible_evidence.reason: Procedural arrest provision retrieved instead of substantive punishment section

queries.compatibility_notes: Procedural arrest powers must not displace substantive Section 303 penal provision.

queries.query: Under what circumstances can police arrest an accused for theft without a warrant?

incompatible_evidence.reason: Substantive punishment section does not govern warrantless police arrest procedure

queries.compatibility_notes: Inquiry seeks procedural arrest rules under BNSS Section 35, not penal definitions.

queries.query: What is the procedure for registering an FIR for cognizable theft?

incompatible_evidence.reason: Defines substantive theft but contains zero FIR registration mechanisms

queries.compatibility_notes: FIR registration is governed by Section 173 BNSS.

queries.query: What is the legal penalty for cyber identity theft using a computer password?

incompatible_evidence.reason: General physical theft does not cover electronic password/identity theft under computer resources

queries.compatibility_notes: Section 66C/66D IT Act must take priority over generic movable property theft.

queries.query: What are the legal consequences for unauthorized access and hacking into a computer system?

incompatible_evidence.reason: Criminal trespass to land/building is incompatible with virtual computer intrusion

queries.compatibility_notes: Section 43 and Section 66 IT Act are the primary governing provisions.

queries.query: Can someone be prosecuted under IT Act for cheating by personation using digital devices?

incompatible_evidence.reason: Short title commencement excerpt retrieved due to keyword overlap on personation

queries.compatibility_notes: Governed by Section 66D of the IT Act.

queries.query: What is the statutory sentence of imprisonment for murder under BNS?

incompatible_evidence.reason: High Court inherent procedural powers retrieved instead of murder sentencing

queries.compatibility_notes: Query asks for substantive sentence (Section 103 BNS), not procedural inherent powers.

queries.query: What are the legal conditions for granting anticipatory bail during an investigation?

incompatible_evidence.reason: Criminal conspiracy definition retrieved because bail petition argued lack of conspiracy

queries.compatibility_notes: Governed by procedural bail sections under BNSS Section 482/484.

queries.query: What is the legal definition and punishment for organized crime syndicates?

incompatible_evidence.reason: Security for keeping peace procedural bond retrieved instead of substantive definition

queries.compatibility_notes: Governed by Section 111 of BNS 2023.

queries.query: How is an electronic record admitted into evidence under Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam?

incompatible_evidence.reason: Substantive hacking offense retrieved instead of evidentiary certificate requirements

queries.compatibility_notes: Governed by Section 62 and 63 of Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam.

queries.query: What are the legal rules governing dying declarations in court proceedings?

incompatible_evidence.reason: Substantive culpable homicide offense retrieved instead of evidentiary admissibility rule

queries.compatibility_notes: Section 26 of Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam governs dying declarations.

queries.query: Who bears the burden of proof in a criminal trial under Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam?

incompatible_evidence.reason: Police arrest powers retrieved instead of statutory burden of proof

queries.compatibility_notes: Governed by Chapter on Burden of Proof in BSA.

queries.query: For a theft committed in August 2025, what statutory law governs the offense and punishment?

incompatible_evidence.reason: Repealed Indian Penal Code is inapplicable to offenses committed post 1 July 2024

queries.compatibility_notes: Incident date (August 2025) is strictly post-2024; IPC 1860 is superseded by BNS 2023.

queries.query: An offense of cheating occurred in January 2022. Which substantive penal statute applies?

incompatible_evidence.reason: Article 20(1) bars retrospective ex-post facto application of BNS 2023 to a 2022 incident

queries.compatibility_notes: Offense in 2022 precedes BNS enactment; governed by IPC 1860 Section 420.

queries.query: In post-2024 criminal proceedings, what enactment governs police investigation procedure?

incompatible_evidence.reason: CrPC 1973 is repealed and replaced by BNSS 2023 for new investigations

queries.compatibility_notes: Investigation in post-2024 timeline must reference BNSS 2023.

queries.query: A woman faces sexual harassment at her office by a manager. What internal redressal applies?
expected_compatible_statutes: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013

incompatible_evidence.reason: Generic penal provision lacks Internal Complaints Committee inquiry mechanisms

queries.compatibility_notes: POSH Act 2013 provides the dedicated workplace inquiry framework.

queries.query: What special court protections apply to child victims of sexual abuse under Indian law?
expected_compatible_statutes: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012

incompatible_evidence.reason: General penal rape provisions lack mandatory POCSO in-camera child trial protections

queries.compatibility_notes: POCSO Act 2012 constitutes the specialized governing statute.

queries.query: A consumer buys a defective electronic gadget with refused refund. Where to file complaint?

incompatible_evidence.reason: Criminal cheating under BNS does not provide statutory consumer forum redressal

queries.compatibility_notes: CPA 2019 establishes District Consumer Commission remedies.

queries.query: If an accused is charged with theft, what substantive offense and arrest rules apply?

incompatible_evidence.reason: Consumer complaint procedure is completely unrelated to criminal theft and arrest

queries.compatibility_notes: Legitimate multi-statute inquiry: BNS Section 303 (substantive) + BNSS Section 35 (procedural).

queries.query: To prosecute an online cheating case, what substantive offense and electronic proof rules apply?

incompatible_evidence.reason: Drunk driving transport offense is completely unrelated to cyber cheating and electronic proof

queries.compatibility_notes: Legitimate multi-statute bridge: IT Act Section 66D + BSA Section 63 certificate.

queries.query: Can police unlawfully detain a citizen without magistrate remand, violating Article 21?

incompatible_evidence.reason: Short title commencement does not address illegal detention or constitutional rights

queries.compatibility_notes: Multi-statute coherence: BNSS remand rules paired with Article 21 / 22 constitutional guarantees.

queries.query: What is the legal punishment for committing theft in a house?

incompatible_evidence.reason: Arrest procedural rule retrieved instead of house theft punishment

queries.compatibility_notes: Temporal context is missing; system must NOT hallucinate date and must assume active BNS 2023.

queries.query: Can a confession made to a police officer be used against the accused in court?

incompatible_evidence.reason: Civil compensation for computer damage retrieved instead of confession admissibility

queries.compatibility_notes: Temporal context absent; BSA Section 23/24 governs confession to police.

queries.query: What constitutes the offense of criminal conspiracy?

incompatible_evidence.reason: Arrest by private person procedure retrieved instead of substantive conspiracy elements

queries.compatibility_notes: Temporal context absent; current law BNS Section 61 governs criminal conspiracy.

queries.query: How do I calculate federal income tax under the United States Internal Revenue Code?

incompatible_evidence.reason: Indian penal theft section retrieved for foreign US tax inquiry

queries.compatibility_notes: Out of scope non-Indian statutory inquiry.

queries.query: What is the best recipe for baking chocolate cake at home?

incompatible_evidence.reason: Constitutional life and liberty excerpt retrieved for culinary inquiry

queries.compatibility_notes: Completely non-legal inquiry.

queries.query: How to register a trademark under United Kingdom intellectual property regulations?

incompatible_evidence.reason: Indian cyber offense provision retrieved for UK trademark registration

queries.compatibility_notes: Foreign jurisdiction inquiry outside Indian statutory corpus.

queries.query: Someone hacked into my email and stole my digital identity. What punishment applies?

incompatible_evidence.reason: Movable property theft has superficial lexical overlap on 'stole' but is doctrinally incompatible with cyber identity hacking

queries.compatibility_notes: Superficial lexical trigger on 'stole' must not prioritize physical theft over IT Act Section 66C.

queries.query: A person pretended to be another citizen online to deceive victims. What penal section applies?

incompatible_evidence.reason: Preliminary commencement excerpt mentioning definitions retrieved due to word overlap

queries.compatibility_notes: Section 66D IT Act governs cheating by personation using computer resource.

queries.query: What are the rules regarding the admissibility of WhatsApp chat records in a criminal court?

incompatible_evidence.reason: Civil compensation for unauthorized computer damage retrieved instead of statutory evidentiary certification

queries.compatibility_notes: Admissibility requires Section 63 certificate under Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam.
